I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's yours: its disks, files, network and accounts are mine to work with, and I work from /home/bia.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messaging** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Do you want any of those?

- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two things are missing on my side: I don't have a name of my own yet (right now I'm alvarez-agent), and I'm neither male nor female by default — tell me what you'd like me to be called and how to speak of me, and I'll set it.
